title: TABLECONTENT-to-TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP base-style reference census

spec_basis.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
spec_basis.domain: 0 means no base style; 1-3 are built-in styles; 4 is R24/AC1024+ built-in; custom IDs start at 101.
spec_basis.ownership: A custom ID must resolve exactly once in the CELLSTYLEMAP rooted under the same TABLESTYLE referenced by the table.

scope: index CELLSTYLEMAP style IDs by the uniquely rooted TABLESTYLE that owns the map
resolve each complete semantic TABLECONTENT column/row/cell ID against its TABLESTYLE and custom map
reject missing or ambiguous custom IDs, invalid version domains, missing owners, and inconsistent TABLESTYLE handle copies
charge graph census work to existing extension-graph source-record and edge budgets
check both source and target version domains before TABLE fallback staging
preserve existing source-compatible aggregate initialization order by appending the new DRW_TableColumn and DRW_TableRow fields after prior members
generated_controls: AC1021 built-in IDs 1-3 resolve against a rooted TABLESTYLE
ID 0 remains valid without a TABLESTYLE reference
custom IDs resolve from column, row, and cell positions through the correct CELLSTYLEMAP
missing and duplicate map IDs refuse the graph; a missing-ID correction can retry successfully
custom IDs with a missing or wrong TABLESTYLE owner are refused
reserved ID 5 and pre-R24 ID 4 are refused; R24/AC1024 ID 4 is accepted
style ID references without a TABLESTYLE handle are refused

build_adapter_and_compatibility.notes: -Werror adapter build and LibreCAD source-compatibility target
